name: M3_OIS340MI_LstSupplSummary
description: List supply alternatives produced by a supply model simulation for a specific customer, item, or customer order. Runs the configured supply model and returns one or more ways demand can be fulfilled, including supplying warehouse, sourcing method (stock, purchase, manufacturing, distribution), proposed quantity, and planned departure and delivery dates and times. Use it to see when and how an item can be supplied before confirming a customer order. Results include availability-to-promise information, replacement indicators, and messages highlighting important conditions or issues for each alternative.

inputParameters.name: CUNO
inputParameters.description: Customer for whom supply alternatives are simulated.

inputParameters.name: POPN
inputParameters.description: Alias number or item number identifying the requested item.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Requested quantity expressed in the specified alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility in which to simulate supply for the requested demand.

inputParameters.name: ORTP
inputParameters.description: Customer order type used as context for the supply model simulation.

inputParameters.name: DWDZ
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery date at the final destination for the simulated demand.

inputParameters.name: DWHZ
inputParameters.description: Requested delivery time at the final destination for the simulated demand.

inputParameters.name: ADID
inputParameters.description: Delivery address number used for the simulated shipment.

inputParameters.name: DECU
inputParameters.description: Delivery (ship-to) customer to use when simulating supply alternatives.

inputParameters.name: SPLM
inputParameters.description: Supply model that defines the rules and alternatives used in the simulation.

inputParameters.name: FTSC
inputParameters.description: Controls whether the system searches all possible supply alternatives (1) or stops at the first valid alternative (0 or blank).

inputParameters.name: BCKO
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether backorders are allowed when simulating supply alternatives.

inputParameters.name: PADL
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether partial deliveries are allowed when proposing supply alternatives.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse to use as the supplying warehouse in the simulation.

inputParameters.name: LTYP
inputParameters.description: Customer order line type to use as the basis for the simulated demand.

inputParameters.name: ALUN
inputParameters.description: Alternate unit of measure used for the requested quantity.

inputParameters.name: ORNO
inputParameters.description: Customer order number to simulate, to run the supply model for a specific existing order.

outputParameters.name: MAR2
outputParameters.description: Shows '*' when one or more messages exist for the supply alternative.

outputParameters.name: MARK
outputParameters.description: Code highlighting special conditions for the alternative, such as replaced or conditionally replaced items.

outputParameters.name: SPLA
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the supply alternative within the supply model.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse to use as the supplying warehouse in the simulation.

outputParameters.name: WHNM
outputParameters.description: Name or description of the supplying warehouse.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the demanded item in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: RITN
outputParameters.description: Item number of the replacement or exchanged item used in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: DSDT
outputParameters.description: Planned departure date for the shipment in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: DSHM
outputParameters.description: Planned departure time for the shipment in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: CODZ
outputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date at the final destination for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: COHZ
outputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery time at the final destination for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: PBQA
outputParameters.description: Proposed deliverable quantity in the alternate unit of measure for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: ALUN
outputParameters.description: Alternate unit of measure used for the requested quantity.

outputParameters.name: AVTP
outputParameters.description: Cumulative available-to-promise quantity considered for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: CNRE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item replacement in this alternative is conditional.

outputParameters.name: CNDN
outputParameters.description: Condition that must be met to use this replacement alternative.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category of the supplying order proposed by this alternative, such as purchase, manufacturing, or distribution.

outputParameters.name: PALT
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this alternative is marked to be selected when other alternatives cannot fulfill the demand.

outputParameters.name: AOPT
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this supply option is automatically selected according to option rules.

outputParameters.name: SPLP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this alternative may supply only part of the demand while other alternatives supply the remainder.

outputParameters.name: BCKO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether backorders are allowed when simulating supply alternatives.

outputParameters.name: PADL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether partial deliveries are allowed when proposing supply alternatives.

outputParameters.name: ATPC
outputParameters.description: Code indicating how available-to-promise is calculated for the item in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: CTPC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether capacity-to-promise checking is applied for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: MTPC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether material-to-promise checking is applied for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: TTPC
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether transportation capacity checks are applied for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: LTYP
outputParameters.description: Customer order line type to use as the basis for the simulated demand.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier responsible for fulfilling this alternative, if supply is sourced from a supplier.

outputParameters.name: SWHL
outputParameters.description: Warehouse that physically supplies the goods for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: ORTY
outputParameters.description: Order type for the supplying order created by this alternative.

outputParameters.name: AFL6
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item number is replaced by the overlength part number for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this alternative affects material planning.

outputParameters.name: PLHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day when this alternative affects material planning.

outputParameters.name: CODT
outputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery date in the local time zone for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: COHM
outputParameters.description: Confirmed delivery time in the local time zone for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: ROUT
outputParameters.description: Transportation route used for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: RODN
outputParameters.description: Route departure identifier used for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: HDPR
outputParameters.description: Main product number if the item belongs to a product family in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: TRQA
outputParameters.description: Supply quantity in the alternate unit of measure for the planned or actual transaction in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: FDDZ
outputParameters.description: First delivery date proposed for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: FDHZ
outputParameters.description: First delivery time proposed for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: LDDZ
outputParameters.description: Last delivery date proposed for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: LDHZ
outputParameters.description: Last delivery time proposed for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: AVDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the quantity becomes available to promise in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time of day associated with this alternative, expressed in hours and minutes.

outputParameters.name: TOMU
outputParameters.description: Issue multiple that the quantity for this alternative is rounded to.

outputParameters.name: SPLM
outputParameters.description: Supply model that defines the rules and alternatives used in the simulation.

outputParameters.name: PREX
outputParameters.description: Priority level of this alternative in the supply model, where 1 is highest.

outputParameters.name: OBV1
outputParameters.description: First control object start value that qualifies this alternative.

outputParameters.name: OBV2
outputParameters.description: Second control object start value that qualifies this alternative.

outputParameters.name: OBV3
outputParameters.description: Third control object start value that qualifies this alternative.

outputParameters.name: OBV4
outputParameters.description: Fourth control object start value that qualifies this alternative.

outputParameters.name: FDAT
outputParameters.description: Start date from which this alternative is valid.

outputParameters.name: TDAT
outputParameters.description: End date until which this alternative is valid.

outputParameters.name: MSEL
outputParameters.description: Indicator used for multiple selection handling for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: COD1
outputParameters.description: Original confirmed delivery date for the demand before any rescheduling during supply simulation.

outputParameters.name: COH1
outputParameters.description: Original confirmed delivery time for the demand before any rescheduling during supply simulation.

outputParameters.name: MCPL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the proposed quantity for this alternative has been manually changed.

outputParameters.name: MSG1
outputParameters.description: First detailed message text for the supply alternative.

outputParameters.name: MSG2
outputParameters.description: Second detailed message text for the supply alternative.

outputParameters.name: MSG3
outputParameters.description: Third detailed message text for the supply alternative.

outputParameters.name: SMIN
outputParameters.description: Additional supply information text associated with this alternative.

outputParameters.name: TX40
outputParameters.description: Description of the supply alternative.

outputParameters.name: MODL
outputParameters.description: Delivery method used for this alternative.

outputParameters.name: PRIP
outputParameters.description: Priority value used when ranking this supply alternative.

outputParameters.name: PODM
outputParameters.description: Delivery method that will be used for the supplying purchase order in this alternative.

outputParameters.name: TRTP
outputParameters.description: Distribution order type used when this alternative creates a supply chain that includes a distribution order.
